# Selected console notices

These unchanged license texts and copyright-header spans supplement seven
dependencies selected by ZITADEL `8afa5dd37a8e723efb9eace8d09fd5c1cccef694`
(4.20.0). Its frozen pnpm lock has SHA-256
`b881c1adea82bb48195b0a5725b041f3a476c45adea565a531172f3ab398ddaf`.
The generated Angular notice remains unchanged. This directory is not a complete
distribution inventory or permission to publish an identity image.

## Exact inputs

`catalogue.json` records the eight package identities: seven notice subjects and
the angularx-qrcode parent needed to select qrcode's actual dependency edge.
The collector pins the catalogue's complete bytes. It records frozen tarball SRI
identities and verifies actual installed package.json bytes, selected complete
source-file digests and retained byte spans. It does not rehash an installed
package into its original registry tarball or verify registry provenance signatures.

| Package | Frozen version | Selected terms and provenance |
| --- | --- | --- |
| qrcode | 1.5.4 | Complete installed lowercase `license`, MIT, Ryan Day 2012. Source: soldair/node-qrcode `3848ed2c17de5bcdead487417dbf14c5dd017f8d`. |
| @ng-icons/core | 33.4.0 | Complete upstream MIT `LICENSE.md`, Ashley Hunter 2024, at ng-icons/ng-icons `d6fe7b79ab95ce9a35feac85a083f3b84a9eb0a3`. |
| grpc-web | 2.0.2 | Complete upstream Apache `LICENSE` at grpc/grpc-web `ea2d8dae34e8cc19df2c1836a5e590a6e30bcb87`; installed Closure Authors header and unchanged leading Google LLC 2018 source header. |
| @connectrpc/connect | 2.1.2 | Complete upstream Apache `LICENSE` at connectrpc/connect-es `104238c58152e324ac16a99563f5eeea8ae7136d` and installed Connect Authors 2021–2026 header. |
| @connectrpc/connect-web | 2.1.2 | Same complete immutable upstream license, with this separate package's installed attribution and metadata. |
| @bufbuild/protobuf | 2.13.0 | Complete upstream Apache `LICENSE` at bufbuild/protobuf-es `0648534fac5eed9a2775807c0ade241de425f244`, installed Buf Technologies 2021–2026 header, and complete Google 2008 BSD block from installed `dist/esm/wire/varint.js`. |
| google-protobuf | 4.0.2 | Both complete installed `LICENSE.md` (BSD) and `LICENSE-asserts.md` (Apache), plus installed Closure Authors header. Source: protocolbuffers/protobuf-javascript `88c63a0bb499e80b58e44409adb9054c284b3974`. |

Every immutable upstream URL, original full-file digest and selected span is in
the catalogue. Source text was independently retrieved during curation. For a
partial immutable-source header, its full original-file digest records that
curation observation; the build verifies the retained selected span, not an
unretained full upstream file. Installed spans are instead checked against the
complete actual installed file before selecting its bytes. The protobuf Google
block includes its generated-code/support-library clarification. No comment
markers, line endings or final blank lines are rewritten.

The ng-icons tarball has no standalone license file or gitHead metadata. Its
decoded registry provenance names `d6fe7b79…`; the release-version commit/tag
`ef86577434b75888d5bdcd1427bc96136c18b74a` has identical license bytes. This is
corroborating source selection, **not cryptographically verified attestation or
package reproducibility**. Its completely inspected bundle has no additional
copyright/license header; the exact bundle digest is retained as identity-only
input, not executable code in a diagnostic artifact.

The seven tarballs and angularx-qrcode 21.0.5 were read completely and matched
their frozen lock's SHA-512 values during curation, without executing package
code. Builds use the existing frozen pnpm installation and the bounded selected
file checks; this is not a new package installation or provenance service.

## Build and output boundary

The explicit Linux recipe supplies this directory to both console snapshot and
inventory phases. The normal website build remains separate. A narrowly checked
relative pnpm alias may resolve directly into this prepared source's `.pnpm`
store; linked parents, linked target components, cycles, absolute/outside targets,
missing files and changed metadata are refused. Peer-suffixed store names are
observed, never guessed. qrcode is selected via angularx-qrcode's exact edge,
not a potentially unrelated hoisted package.

The pre-compilation snapshot contains checked selected bytes and all observed
identities. After compilation, the collector compares the complete fresh state.
It renders those checked bytes into `console-notices-supplement.txt` without an
unchecked copy. Each section's offset/length/hash identifies its verbatim bytes
inside separate deterministic framing. The compact inventory binds the original
Angular notice inventory and its current receipt/binary/recipe, the catalogue,
installed inputs, selected alias identities and text. It cannot replace another
build's evidence. Failed reads, writes, subprocesses or finalization yield no
build-success receipt; existing diagnostic files are never overwritten.

CI retains only the exact supplementary inventory JSON and the existing bounded
text diagnostics. It does not retain tarballs, executable JavaScript, node_modules,
the prepared source tree, pre-compilation snapshot or service binary.

The other generated sections, Go/toolchain terms, other copied assets, image
packaging, corresponding source, restricted runtime and authenticated publication
remain #308/#305 work. Overall `licenseClosure` and `imageAdmission` stay
`unknown`. This does not enable customer identity or the portal.
